description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractErrorParser' used for parsing error responses in AWS SDK for PHP. It contains methods for extracting payloads from HTTP responses and populating error shape data structures based on API operation errors.

classes.name: AbstractErrorParser
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for parsing error responses received from AWS API calls, including payload extraction and error shape population.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the parser with an optional AWS Service object.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for parsing the payload from a response.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload data from the response, either by parsing a structured shape or returning the response body stream.

methods.name: populateShape
methods.description: Populates the error shape data with information from the response, handling different error locations like headers and status code, and associating with known error shapes based on the command.
